report:
Native liver, total hepatectomy

Received fresh is a native liver weighing 820 g and measuring 19 x 13 x 6 cm. The hilar margins (bile duct, portal vein and hepatic artery) are submitted en face. The gallbladder is absent. One hilar lymph node is identified. The liver is serially sliced at 5 mm intervals. The parenchyma is soft and mottled, with extensive necrosis. No mass or prominent nodule is seen. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(1) Hilar margins en face.
(2-8) Liver parenchyma, all segments.
(9) Hilar lymph node.

There is massive hepatic necrosis, involving about 85% of the parenchyma in a panacinar pattern, with parenchymal collapse and ductular reaction. There is no fibrosis. One hilar lymph node shows reactive changes. There is no dysplasia or malignancy.

LIVER, native, total hepatectomy - MASSIVE HEPATIC NECROSIS
